title: Actually
subtitle: 「其實／事實上」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「其實／事實上」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.note: 根據語境選擇最貼切的說法。

exercises.original: I thought the meeting was at nine, but ___ it starts at ten.
exercises.upgrade: I thought the meeting was at nine, but ___ it starts at ten.

options.explanation: 四個都可能成立，但 actually 最自然地用來直接修正原先錯誤認知。

words.note: 和 actually 最接近、最常互換的表達之一。
words.example: I thought the shop was closed, but in fact it was still open.
words.exampleZh: 我原以為商店關門了，但其實它仍然營業。

words.note: 在口語中，really 常可表達 actually 的「真正情況／真正想法」。
words.example: I don't really want to leave yet.

exercises.original: What I ___ need is a few more days.
exercises.upgrade: What I ___ need is a few more days.

options.explanation: 本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.note: 當表面印象、理論或想像與真實情況不同時，非常接近 actually。
words.example: The job looked easy, but in reality it was extremely demanding.
words.exampleZh: 這份工作看起來很容易，但實際上要求非常高。

exercises.original: The plan looks simple on paper, but ___ it is extremely complicated.
exercises.upgrade: The plan looks simple on paper, but ___ it is extremely complicated.

options.explanation: 這裡是典型的「表面／理論 vs 真實情況」。

words.note: 非常接近 in fact，也常可代替 actually 來補充或糾正事實。
words.example: I don't dislike the idea. As a matter of fact, I think it's quite good.
words.exampleZh: 我並不討厭這個想法。其實，我覺得它相當不錯。

exercises.original: I don't dislike the proposal. ___, I think it's one of the better options.
exercises.upgrade: I don't dislike the proposal. ___, I think it's one of the better options.

options.explanation: 本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
第二句補充一個比第一句更強的事實：不只是「不討厭」，而是「覺得很好」。

words.note: 在加強或確認前面說法時，和 actually / in fact 很接近。
words.example: The task was difficult. Indeed, several experienced staff members struggled with it.
words.exampleZh: 這項任務很困難。事實上，幾名有經驗的員工也應付得很吃力。

exercises.original: The task was difficult. ___, even the most experienced staff struggled.
exercises.upgrade: The task was difficult. ___, even the most experienced staff struggled.

options.explanation: 本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.note: 比 in fact 稍正式、稍強調真實情況。
words.example: The building looks ancient, but in actual fact it is only twenty years old.

exercises.original: The building looks old, but ___ it was completed only ten years ago.

words.note: 較正式或文學化，但在揭示真正情況時與 actually 很接近。

words.note: 非常正式，常見於辯論、法律或正式評論。

falseSynonyms.zh: apparently = 看來／據說。 它通常表示不完全確定，而 actually 表示真實情況。
falseSynonyms.point: Apparently, he left. Actually, he stayed.

falseSynonyms.zh: currently = 目前。 和 actually 完全不同。
falseSynonyms.point: Currently, she works in London. Actually, she works in finance.

falseSynonyms.zh: basically = 基本上／簡單來說。 它用來概括，不是揭示真實情況。
obviously = 顯然。 它表示事情容易看出，不是「其實」。
literally = 按字面地。 不是一般性的「事實上」。
